questions.q: What must be set to a valid URL before SSDT can deploy a report project at all?
options: OutputPath
TargetServerURL
ErrorLevel
StartItem
questions.explain: TargetServerURL must point at a real report server before you can publish anything — SSDT refuses to deploy without it.

questions.q: How does TargetServerURL differ from the web portal's URL?
options: The web portal URL is what SSDT deploys to, not TargetServerURL
TargetServerURL points at the report server's virtual directory (e.g. /reportserver), while the web portal uses a different, human-facing virtual directory (e.g. /reports)
They are always identical for native-mode servers
TargetServerURL is only used in SharePoint mode
questions.explain: The web portal (/reports) is where humans browse content; the report server's virtual directory (/reportserver) is the machine-facing endpoint SSDT actually publishes to. Mixing them up causes deployment to fail.

questions.q: What are SSDT's three default project configurations?
options: Build, Deploy, and Preview
Native, SharePoint, and PowerBI
DebugLocal, Debug, and Release
Test, Staging, and Production
questions.explain: SSDT provides DebugLocal (local preview only), Debug (typically a test server), and Release (typically production) as its three default configurations.

questions.q: Which commands deploy a whole report server project?
options: Only the Report Server Project Wizard can deploy
Right-click Solution Explorer and choose Add New Item
File > Save As
Build menu > Deploy Solution, or right-click the project in Solution Explorer and choose Deploy Solution
questions.explain: Both the Build menu's Deploy Solution command and the project's right-click Deploy Solution command publish every report and shared data source in the project together.

questions.q: If a report depends on a shared data source that isn't already on the report server, what happens if you deploy only the report?
options: SSDT blocks the deployment entirely and shows no output
The published report won't run — the shared data source needs to be deployed too
The report deploys fine and creates its own copy of the data source
SSDT automatically deploys the data source for you with no action needed
questions.explain: If a report uses a shared data source, that data source must also be deployed to the server, or the deployed report won't have anything to connect to.
